endpoints.notes: Chat2API audio conversation extension; consumes an owner-scoped audio_file_id and returns JSON audio/transcript data.
Custom chat2api-live-v1 full-duplex PCM/WebSocket protocol; not OpenAI Realtime WebSocket wire compatibility.
Issues a one-time 60-second Chat2API realtime session token; this is not the standard OpenAI client_secrets route.
GPT-Live speech generation returns JSON containing base64 audio and diagnostics; it does not implement the standard binary audio/speech response contract.
Text and supported uploaded image/file references. Default prompt_mode=full preserves the ordered multi-turn transcript. Client extension fields may appear in output.
Legacy text completions adapter over Chat Completions; prompt is converted to one user turn and usage remains estimated.
Supports standard multipart file upload for assistants, vision and user_data purposes, plus the legacy Chat2API JSON/base64 extension. batch/fine-tune/evals purposes are unsupported.
Returns standard FileDeleted {id, object, deleted}; owner-scoped.
Returns standard FileObject metadata (created_at Unix seconds, status=processed) with Chat2API mime_type extension; owner scoped.
Returns owner-scoped binary file bytes; no list endpoint is currently implemented.
Returns owner-scoped Chat2API generated-file metadata and signed download URL.
gpt-image only; requires active image-capable Worker and images scope.
Returns owner-scoped Chat2API media metadata and signed asset URLs; binary assets are served by /api/media capability URLs.
Only currently online model catalog; requires models scope.
Retrieves an online model from the current browser-backed catalog; offline or unknown models return not-found.
Owner-scoped native page snapshot sidecar; not an OpenAI Responses resource.
Owner-scoped native snapshot update SSE; presentation-only stream and not a generation terminal authority.
Text, native web search, hosted images and selected emulated tools via later patch layers; do not infer complete Responses feature parity.
Best-effort bounded in-process response store, not durable OpenAI storage semantics.

capabilities.evidence: Chat completion response with assistant message, stop, estimated usage.
SSE data frames; final stop chunk with usage, then [DONE]; extra status/reasoning deltas may occur.
system/developer/user/assistant/tool history converted into ordered prompt blocks; not native token/role handling by the upstream model.
Chat Completions tools/tool_choice are not guaranteed to yield OpenAI-native tool_calls; Responses emulation is separate.
Unknown Chat extras are accepted by Pydantic but JSON schema/response_format is not enforced at transport layer.
token_usage.usage_for estimator, not authoritative upstream OpenAI billing.
model in standard envelope is requested model; actual served-model evidence is tracked separately.
Web search and image_generation with specific emulated function tools; arbitrary hosted tool compatibility not asserted.
Standard multipart files.create supported for assistants, vision and user_data; batch/fine-tune/evals unsupported; legacy JSON/base64 extension remains.
HTTPException and FastAPI request-validation failures under /v1 use {error:{message,type,param,code}}; endpoint-specific direct error responses still require contract tests.
Managed API-key scopes chat/models/files/images enforced by endpoints.
ModeResolverMiddleware defaults /v1 to mode2; mode1 rejected.
Speech and realtime routes use Chat2API-specific request/response/wire formats; the legacy audio transcription route is not exposed by the composed app.
POST /v1/completions maps a prompt to the Chat Completions worker bridge.
The legacy v7 route is explicitly removed by v9 from the composed production app; no /v1/audio/transcriptions route is exposed.

Official Python and Node SDKs exercise POST /v1/images/generations against the real ASGI route with deterministic image.completed Worker output; real Chrome image generation remains an external release gate.
